name: CheckSent-BN: Bengali Multi-Task Dataset for Claim Checkworthiness and Sentiment Classification
description: CheckSent-BN is a multi-task dataset of 11,500 Bengali news headlines annotated for claim checkworthiness detection and sentiment analysis. Introduced at BLP-2025, the dataset addresses fact-checking and automated content verification in Bengali media through combined LLM-annotation and native-speaker human verification.
